limitations: Only the 24 addendum URLs were re-inspected; this is not a full census of the 98 sitemap URLs and no coverage, ranking, traffic or revenue claim is made.
URL Inspection reflects Google's state at inspection time; the /traslados coverage label is volatile and the dataset records the observed history rather than a timeless label.
Only the read-only Webmasters and URL Inspection APIs were used; no Search Console coverage/performance export or UI was used.
The mutation harness cloned and mutated datasets in memory against the real validator; no real dataset, script or repository file was modified.

Two residual documentation inconsistencies remain outside the specified C-01 correction set (R-06 satellite wording, R-07 historical DECISION-LOG D-067); they do not affect the stable classification or any indexation claim.
